title: Health Resort east wing room 205 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 205 of the East wing in Health Resort on Shoreline

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 205 key (E205 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 205.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 206 through the balcony.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - Spawns on a cardboard box, in the fenced off concrete area above the stream to the north of the resort

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 205 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 205:
  - 2× Medcase
  - 1× Sports bag
  - 1× Weapon cabinet
  - Loose loot (Currency)
- Room 206:
  - Red keycard spawn location
  - 2× Weapon box (6x2)
  - 2× Weapon box (4x4)
  - 1× Weapon Spawn (AKM)
  - 1× Weapon Spawn (AKS-74UB)
  - Rare loose loot
  - Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies)
